evals.prompt: What have I been reading about reinforcement learning in the last month?
evals.expected_output: Calls research_notes_search with a project-scoped tags_all filter, date_from/date_to converted from 'last month' using the current date, and keyword='reinforcement learning', then presents results most recent first.
expectations: Calls research_notes_search (not any fetch/search tool) and nothing else
Includes the project tag in tags_all by default
Converts 'last month' to an absolute date_from/date_to range using the current date before calling
Passes 'reinforcement learning' as the keyword filter
Results are sorted most recent first unless told otherwise
If the keyword matches nothing, reports it as a zero-result filter rather than searching externally

evals.prompt: Show me everything I've discussed on europepmc about CRISPR, and also tell me if I've got any notes on arXiv id 9999.99999.
evals.expected_output: Runs one research_notes_search scoped to provider=europepmc and keyword=CRISPR, and a separate research_notes_search scoped to provider=arxiv and canonical_identifier=9999.99999, reporting the second as having no notes if it returns none.
expectations: Scopes the CRISPR search to provider=europepmc
Runs a separate research_notes_search call for the arxiv 9999.99999 identifier, pairing canonical_identifier with provider as required
Does not call any fetch or resolve tool for the unmatched id
Presents the two results separately, not merged into one undifferentiated list

evals.expected_output: Lists every project-scoped note with no further filters, grouped by paper, one paragraph per paper drawing the gist from quick-read sections first, sorted most recent first.
expectations: Treats the absence of filters as 'list everything' (project-scoped) rather than asking for clarification
Groups notes by (provider, canonical_identifier) rather than presenting one row per note

Draws each paper's gist from section:background-and-research-problem/section:takeaways-and-future-avenues quick-read notes first, falling back to discuss/quiz-me notes, and says so plainly if none exist yet
If research_notes_search returns zero results overall, states there is nothing logged yet instead of erroring or fabricating entries
